description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class which provides business logic for managing employee membership data, including CRUD operations and search functionalities, within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Provides methods for managing employee memberships, including CRUD operations and search functionality within the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazily instantiates and retrieves the EmployeeMembershipDao object.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership entity using the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership by employee number and membership ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Performs a search for employee memberships based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee memberships matching the search filter.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple employee memberships for a given employee.
